protocol.selectionCriterion: Compute per-family median relative loss reduction at final generation (g=3) of evolving_ser_reset vs fixed_ser_reset and vs each tuned conventional baseline (sgd, adam, bfgs). Rank candidates by compositeScore = 0.5 * min_family(medianProposerRelative) + 0.5 * min_{family,conv}(medianConvRelative). Deterministic tie-break: higher min_family(medianProposerRelative), then declaration order.
